create_halfnormal_distribution: create a HalfNormal distribution from torch with a given scale tensor
retrieve_halfnormal_scale: retrieve the scale parameter from a HalfNormal distribution instance
compute_halfnormal_mean: compute the mean of a HalfNormal distribution from its scale
compute_halfnormal_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a HalfNormal distribution
compute_halfnormal_entropy: compute the entropy of a HalfNormal distribution
